blog_suggestion.title: Why Decisioning Platforms Built for One Industry Hit a Ceiling
blog_suggestion.angle: SAS argues that purpose-built, single-vertical decisioning tools lack the governance architecture and cross-domain adaptability required as regulated industries converge.
blog_suggestion.why_now: Leadership transitions at niche decisioning vendors signal market maturation and the right moment to challenge vertical lock-in narratives.

blog_suggestion.title: First-Party Fraud Is a Governance Problem, Not Just a Data Problem
blog_suggestion.angle: Detecting first-party fraud requires traceable, explainable decisioning models — not just third-party data enrichment — to satisfy regulators and pass audits.
blog_suggestion.why_now: Provenir's webinar and Markaaz partnership are framing fraud as a data coverage issue, creating an opening for SAS to lead with governance and explainability.
